mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 8.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in the demand for goods and services, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply chain disruption regime characterized by declining industrial production (INDPRO) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to stagflationary pressures on corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or Rank IC for the regime condition remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for the interaction term remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 220), an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) accelerates the real interest rate, suppressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 220 and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC for the regime condition remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
